briefing.headline: Soft landing intact as job gains keep growth afloat despite inflation's modest uptick.

quotable_numbers.sentence: Core CPI at 2.56 percent for Sep 2026 sits near the Fed's target, letting rates stay steady.
Unemployment at 4.1 percent for Oct 2026 ticked down, anchoring household demand.

briefing.whats_new: Today: US Dollar index firmer, from 122.65 to 123.60.
